intro.text: Long ago, wherever the golden toad Jin Chan travelled, luck followed. Ponds sparkled, lotuses bloomed, and every frog knew the way home.
Then a great storm swept through. It drained the colour from every pond and scattered the frogs far from home.
“Only Jin Chan can bring the ponds back to life,” whispers Old Liu the willow. “Help each lost frog hop home, and the luck will flow again.”
Every frog knows only one way: forward. Clear the path, then free Jin Chan.

beats.text: A little frog named Dou Dou stays behind. “I want to help Jin Chan!” it croaks. Ahead, the pond’s currents begin to swirl.

end.text: The mist lifts. The Moon Bridge glows again.

start.text: Beyond the bridge lies the Lantern Marsh, dark and silent. Snakes sleep among the reeds. “Wake none,” warns Old Liu. “Kindness is quieter than courage.”

beats.text: Dou Dou hops beside Jin Chan, whispering each frog’s name as it goes home. One by one, the marsh lanterns flicker.

end.text: A thousand lanterns light the shrine. Another pond is waiting…
